description:
Read .lattice/notes/design-decisions-2026-07-04.md first. It binds this task.

Build the bridge between evaluation runs and the site. analysis.py already loads inspect logs into pandas. Extend it into a repeatable pipeline with one entry point:

1. Read logs from logs/.
2. Produce one tidy record per sample: model, reasoning setting, dialect and its full transform chain, suite version, difficulty, depth, steps, correct or not, tokens, cost.
3. Compute the headline per-model sensitivity score: paired accuracy drop against the canonical dialect over the frozen suite, with McNemar tests and bootstrap confidence intervals over items.
4. Write versioned parquet or JSON artifacts the site bakes charts from.
5. Extract per-sample transcripts for walkthrough pages.

The pairing key is the seeded case id; verify it is stable across renderer runs by checking how case ids are generated in core.py. Counts must reconcile with log totals — no silent sample drops. The site (DB-6) and release skill (DB-8) consume this.
title: Results data pipeline: inspect logs to tidy site-ready data
